verse.text: No discipline is enjoyable while it is happening—it's painful! But afterward there will be a peaceful harvest of right living for those who are trained in this way.

video.title: The Benefits of Discipline | Hebrews 12:11 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: No dad enjoys the hard moments—holding a boundary when your kid melts down, having the tough conversation, staying consistent when it'd be easier to let it slide. But that steady, loving correction is exactly what grows character in your kids over the long haul. Keep training them today; the harvest comes later, and it's worth it.
